html:
Performers
Orquesta Sinfónica de Madrid (orchestra), Enrique Fernández Arbós (conductor) Documented

The Internet Archive item calls the orchestra the Madrid Symphony Orchestra; Columbia’s Spanish catalogue names it Orquesta Sinfónica de Madrid, director E. Fernández Arbós. Individual players are not identified.

[1] [3]
Work version
Orchestral concert version of the Miller’s Dance, issued as the second of three dances from the ballet Inferred, not documented

The 78 set carries Los vecinos, Danza del molinero and Danza final, the three dances of the second suite as the Los Angeles Philharmonic note lists them. The orchestral edition used and any cuts are unknown.

[1] [3] [4]
Recorded
1928-04-18 Documented

Stated in the discographical note of the Internet Archive item. Columbia’s catalogue gives no session dates.

[1]
Place
Madrid Documented

Stated in the Internet Archive item’s discographical note; the studio or hall is not named.

[1]
Label
Columbia Documented

Twelve-inch 78-rpm discs.

[1] [3]
Catalogue
Columbia 9683–⁠9684 (original series); AG 8043 and AG 8044 (Columbia’s Spanish catalogue of 1954) Documented

The Spanish catalogue pairs “Danza del molinero” with “Los vecinos” on AG 8043 and gives “Danza final” in two parts on AG 8044.

[1] [3]
Matrix, take, sides
Four sides, matrices WKX 79-2, 80-1, 77-2, 78-1; this dance fills one side Documented

The item lists the four matrices together. Which matrix belongs to the Danza del molinero is not stated.

[1] [3]
Transfer
Satyr 78rpm collection, Internet Archive Documented

The item is in the Internet Archive’s satyr78rpm collection; no personal mastering credit is given.

[1]
Transfer date
Unknown Unknown

The item was uploaded on 24 March 2026; the date of the transfer itself is not stated.

[1]
Processing
Unknown Unknown

Equipment, equalisation and restoration settings are not stated.

[1]
Composition rights
Falla died on 14 November 1946. Spanish law protects the works of authors who died before 7 December 1987 for life plus 80 years, so his music remains protected in Spain until the end of 2026; arrangements and modern editions carry their own rights Documented

A phonogram term assessment does not clear the composition, an arrangement or a modern score edition.

[6] [7]
Recording rights
Territorial EU phonogram public-domain basis: published no later than 1954, before 1963 Inferred, not documented

The discs are listed in Columbia’s Spanish catalogue of 78 r.p.m. discs published up to 1 January 1954, and were recorded in 1928; the actual first issue date is not established here. This is a territorial phonogram basis, not US or worldwide clearance and not a Creative Commons licence.

[1] [3]

Falla, El sombrero de tres picos, Danza del molinero; Orquesta Sinfónica de Madrid, Enrique Fernández Arbós. Columbia 9683–⁠9684 (AG 8043), Internet Archive transfer. Territorial EU phonogram basis only; Falla’s composition remains protected in Spain until the end of 2026.
